name: 18249 · Sugarloaf, PA
findings: ZIP 18249 (Sugarloaf) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18249 (Sugarloaf) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 18249 (Sugarloaf) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
